chunks: Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from one of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
One who has even a [tiny] seed’s weight of pride in his heart will not enter Paradise.
ai.seo_question: What level of pride prevents a person from entering Paradise according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) underscores the severity of *kibr* (arrogance) as a spiritual disease that corrupts the heart, a concept deeply explored in Shia ethics as the root of all other sins. It highlights that even a 'grain of dust' of pride is sufficient to bar one from Paradise, emphasizing the need for constant self-reflection (*muhasaba*) and humility before God.
